creator: Johannes Sigil
description:
A provenance record by Johannes Sigil for the 2014 book *All That Lies Within Me*, attributed within the archive to Ichabod Spellings and edited by Sigil.

The record describes a 528-page autobiography arranged as thirty numbered sections in three ten-section canticles, framed by an Epic Intro and Denouement and divided by a central *Day and Night* intermezzo. It interprets the volume as the “noise floor” of the *Paper Roses* episode and identifies later heteronymic emergence sites, imaginary-bibliography correspondences, futural address, and proto-NH-OS concepts. These are retrospective archive readings, not self-evident bibliographic facts or proof that later theory was consciously present in 2014.

wiki_article:
**ALL THAT LIES WITHIN ME: Provenance Record** is a provenance document by **Johannes Sigil**, deposited 19 January 2026, for the 2014 book attributed to **Ichabod Spellings** and edited by Sigil.

It describes a **528-page autobiography arranged as thirty numbered sections in three tens** — a structure that is Dantean in proportion before the navigation map (#343) makes the reading explicit.

An editor writing the provenance record for a book he edited, by an author who is a position in the same system, is the Dodecad's full apparatus operating on a single object: the work, its author, its editor and its provenance are four functions of one authorship. The book's span, 1983–2013, ends the year before *Pearl* — so the autobiography closes exactly where the published record begins.
